verdict_rule: Each criterion is graded from its THRESHOLDS entry. A capability's verdict is the worst of its evidence criteria and its documented scope cap. overall = worst(all criteria + all capabilities) with FAIL > PARTIAL > PASS. correctness_verdict = worst over the correctness criteria only (excludes timing, default-solve quality and scale).

C1-kuhn-analytic.reference: Kuhn (1950): P0 game value -1/18; alpha-family equilibrium structure

C3-river-closed-form.reference: polarized river toy, closed form: air bet B/(P+B), call P/(P+B), EV0 PB/(2(P+B))

C4-sizing-menu.reference: menu {5,20}: equilibrium value = max single-size closed-form value; small size unused

C6-br-oracle-agreement.metric: |repo nash_conv (or 3p unilateral certificate) - independent oracle| / max(1, |oracle|)

C7-kuhn3-analytic.reference: 3-player Kuhn (Szafron, Gibson & Sturtevant 2013): seat1 = -1/48, seat0 in [-3/48,-1/48], seat2 in [1/24,1/12]
C7-kuhn3-analytic.pass_seat1_error: <= final nash_conv (heuristic: n-player has no minimax bound)

C8-determinism.requirement: identical params -> identical strategy, action values and params_hash; MCCFR identical for equal seeds and different for different seeds; catalog deterministic

C9-param-sensitivity.requirement: each perturbation (iterations, pot, bet size, villain range, stack) changes params_hash AND the solved strategy or action values
C9-param-sensitivity.partial: every params_hash changes but some output is unchanged

C10-score-crosscheck.requirement: practice Q / strategy / pot / score / grade == independent recomputation

C11-practice-solve-quality.metric: exploitability % of starting pot = 100 * (NashConv / n_players) / spot.pot at the family default solve (NashConv from the independent oracle)

C12-practice-timing.metric: cold SolverAdapter.solve wall time at the family default (empty cache)
C12-practice-timing.source: W4 CONTRACT cold budget 20 s; server timeout 90 s

C13-equity-icm.requirement: exact equity == hand-derived win/tie/loss counts; ICM == Malmuth-Harville finishing-order enumeration

C14-scale.metric: projected seconds for 1000 vanilla-CFR iterations on a single-bet-size river with 100 combos per side (power-law fit of s/iteration vs deals; a LOWER bound for realistic multi-size trees)

C15-all-in.requirement: all-in-only wager tree: zero-sum terminals, all-in showdowns reached, NashConv decreases; no RAISE whose target equals the CALL target and no decision node for a seat with 0 chips behind
C15-all-in.partial: value checks pass and the structural defect is value-neutral (gap <= 1e-9)

C16-mixed-strategy.requirement: where theory requires a strictly mixed equilibrium action (Kuhn P1 J-bluff and Q-call = 1/3; river-toy air bet = B/(P+B)) the solver's mix lies strictly inside

criteria.title: All-in edge case: tree structure, zero-sum, convergence

thresholds.requirement: all-in-only wager tree: zero-sum terminals, all-in showdowns reached, NashConv decreases; no RAISE whose target equals the CALL target and no decision node for a seat with 0 chips behind
thresholds.partial: value checks pass and the structural defect is value-neutral (gap <= 1e-9)

no degenerate RAISE==CALL facing all-in.defect: multistreet.MultiStreetState.legal_actions offers RAISE(target==call target) when the all-in shove target equals the call amount; the all-in players then get CHECK-only decision nodes. Value-neutral (gap above) but bloats the tree and lets practice users pick a 'raise' that is a call.

gaps: bounded abstraction only: fixed wager menus, explicit tiny ranges (<= ~5 combos/side in the catalog), enumerated runout subsets; no full-range NLHE solve

single wager size per spot in the catalog, <= 4 enumerated runouts, tiny ranges
flop->river and turn->river only over an explicit runout subset (not all 49x48 runouts)
icm.calculate_icm_equity is an evaluator only; no ICM-aware solve path in the solver facades or practice mode
fixed menus; practice spots expose one size; off-tree user sizes are snapped, never solved
